title: 1801 Prairie gains its corner porch and sweeping front stair
items: The Kimball house's open corner porch now stands at the 18th Street end of the front, as J. W. Taylor's photograph of about 1895 shows: a round stone arch on each face, the double door inside, and a small stone balcony under the 18th Street arch.
A broad stone stair of nine steps now comes down the front out of the porch, between side walls that sweep down to blocks at the foot.
Still to come: the carving round the arches and on the porch, the bowed bay and the front's carved windows.
